svg.text: Three variants for the cold-start hero, A is chosen: it carries every action and the other books being read. After the first visit Home shows the slim strip.
1 Cold start: the hero (viewport 1250 px high: 32 % of it)
A text | big cover | also reading (chosen)
Chapter 5 · about 2 h 30 min left · 40% completed
Lewis Carroll · 40% · about 2 h 30 min left
C progress ring, one action and a menu
2 Later visits to Home in the same session: the strip (64 px card, 88 px with margins)
3 Resize ladder of variant A: the layout follows the width of the book area, the height follows the viewport
Chapter 5 · about 2 h 30 min left · 40% completed
medium 640-900 px: smaller cover, one More menu
strip 420-640 px, or a viewport under 928 px high
mini < 420 px: title and play button
scrolled: it shrinks to the strip, then slides off
← shrinks from the hero first (no jump of the books), then slides off
Colours: the dominant colour of the cover, saturation capped, pastel in light mode and deep in dark mode; the text colour has at least 4.5:1 contrast on both ends of the gradient.
